description: exp020 - exact copy of exp019 (single-stream champion lineage + HyperplaneCodeLUT nap15/T16 unembedder, E=384) with ONE change: hyperplane_init='random' with hyperplane_init_scale=0.05 (Gaussian N(0,0.05^2) ~ 1/sqrt(384), bias 0) for ALL LUTs - the qk/v/out_proj HyperplaneMultiHeadLUT sites AND the HyperplaneCodeLUT unembedder's hyperplane_weight/bias. w_cell keeps const 0.02 (near-uniform). Everything else identical to exp019: single residual stream, LayerNorm everywhere incl ln_final before the code-LUT, 6 layers, 6 heads d_qk=d_v=64, ctx512, vocab32768, RoPE1e4, untied tok_emb, LUT qk nap4/tph256 v nap6/tph256 out_proj nap7/tph512 (hard), seed 42, 16000 steps, 24576 tokens/step, LR over 16000 (warmup1600 cosine 0.1x floor), Lion lut_lr 2e-4 tables / AdamW adam_lr 3e-4 (hyperplane w/b no-wd by name, w_cell wd0.1, tok_emb/norms wd0), grad clip 1.0, eval every 500. Required adding a random-init-scale path to hyperplane_code_lut.py (backward-compatible). Motivation: exp012 showed random ties anchor for the backbone; random may suit the code-LUT unembedder better. Baselines: exp010 dual-stream 1.1940, exp019 anchor-init single-stream.
